messages:
Mina: Quick request — can someone run a smoke + cost snapshot for a new model `lilypad-7b` (fp16 + int8) before we consider a canary? Targets: p95 < 120ms for seq=32, tail p99 < 350ms. Also need tokens/sec and rough $/M tokens estimate. Please include seq=32 and seq=128 runs.

Evan: I can take this. Scheduling bench job now on A10G pool (single node). Plan: smoke + steady-state for seq=[32,128], batch=[1,4,8], duration=120s per config. Job: https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/8792 (queued).

Sam: +1. Please include quantized int8 variant and KV cache on/off. For int8 use `--quantize=llm-int8` and capture `gpu_mem` and `gpu_util`.

Talia: Results posted from run 8792:
```
model,variant,seq,batch,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tok_s,mem_gpu_MB,est_cost_per_M_tokens
lilypad-7b,fp16,32,1,85,210,1250,6200,$18.5
lilypad-7b,fp16,32,8,95,260,7600,8200,$3.1
lilypad-7b,int8,32,1,92,240,1180,4800,$11.2
lilypad-7b,int8,128,4,240,560,3200,7600,$2.6
```
Notes: cold-start 1st-token spike ~1100ms on fp16 (single-shot). Memory footprint within expected range. p99 for seq=128 (int8) exceeds our tail target.

qa-bot: automated-smoke: basic generation smoke tests: PASS. Evals: small prompt set passes sanity checks. :white_check_mark:

Ryan: The p99=560ms for seq=128 batch=4 int8 is concerning. Do we know if this is kernel fallback / memory thrash? Can we run a seq=256 cold-start to see worst-case?

Evan: Suspect attention kernel fallback on longer sequences. I'll run a profiler trace. Command used for the failing config:
```
./bench_runner --model lilypad-7b --seq 128 --batch 4 --quantize int8 --kvcache on --duration 120 --reporter json
```
Job link for profiler: https://ci.redwood.ai/profiler/6721

Talia: Profiler snippet (relevant lines):
```
[00:12:11] GPU Utilization: 78%
[00:12:12] kernel select: flash_attn failed -> fallback gemm_mm_tiled
[00:12:46] p99 latency spikes correlated with gemm_mm_tiled steps
[00:13:20] mem peak 7600MB (int8)
```
Conclusion: fallback to slower kernel for some attention shapes on seq>=128.

Mina: Ok — options: A) tune kernel selector / disable fallback for the canary, B) limit canary to seq<=64 until we fix. Prefer B unless we can patch quickly. Thoughts?

Evan: I agree with B for safety. I'll open a PR to pin kernel selection and add a regression test (tracking issue #3124). If PR is quick we can revisit.

Talia: Confirmed — I'll re-run int8 config with seq=64 batch=8 and post numbers by EOD.

Sam: Also adding `--quantize=int8` to onboarding checklist and creating a short test in CI to catch p99 regressions for seq=64/128.

deploy-bot: Canary build will be queued automatically when thread labeled `canary-ready`. Current status: waiting for `canary-ready` label.

Mina: Great work — action items: Evan PR for kernel selector + regression test (#3124), Talia re-run seq=64 int8 and post results, Sam update onboarding checklist, I will hold canary to seq<=64 and schedule rollout once we have new numbers. Thanks all. :pray:
